scope: Synthetic two-image, two-step optimizer execution and state restoration; no useful-learning or capacity claim.
method: Isolated GPU acceptance workspace, public JobStore/RunService prepare/start/saved_states/restore_state lifecycle. Two synthetic captioned images per family; no final samples or periodic previews.
reproduction_scenario: Use the image-only datasets. For each optimizer choose 256x256, rank8 Wan/rank4 H3, two steps, save every step, save training state, final sample off. Wan uses alternating experts with interval1; AdamW8bit uses Sigmoid scale1.5. Restore the final save for two more total Wan updates or one H3 update.
limits: No useful-learning judgement, production-size capacity, runtime memory peaks or speed comparison.
Retention is unlimited in these optimizer checks; retention/Stop/preview interactions have separate synthetic regression coverage.
Both families reuse hash-verified latent/text caches for the second optimizer. Wan restores both experts; H3 restored optimizer counter must reach3.
